Choose Your World

Every great story needs a foundation. Choose from our curated worlds, or bring your own universe to life.

Curated Worlds

Rich, detailed settings ready for your story:

⚔

The Shattered Kingdoms

A realm fractured by an ancient war. Noble houses vie for power while darker forces stir in the shadows. Deeply detailed political intrigue and high fantasy.

🌳

Thornwood Chronicles

A mystical forest where fey courts hold sway. Ancient pacts, forbidden love, and the boundaries between worlds. Perfect for romance, mystery, or dark fairy tales.

✨

Fresh Canvas

Start with nothing. Let the world emerge from your story. The AI will create lore as you play, building a unique mythology together.
